activities.title: Draw what is in your pocket
activities.summary: Put a few everyday objects on a table and make a small drawing of them.
steps: Choose 2 or 3 objects you already have.
Draw their outlines, then add one detail that makes each object recognizable.
Choose one object and draw it again from another side.
activities.shared_version: Compare the objects you each chose, or draw the same arrangement.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Draw a room with one continuous line
activities.summary: Keep your pen moving as you draw part of a room.
steps: Choose one corner of a room and a place to sit.
Draw what you see without lifting your pen. Leave mistakes in the picture.
Start a second version and follow a different route through the same scene.
activities.shared_version: Sit in different places and compare how the room looks from each one.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Make a tiny texture collection
activities.summary: Fill a page with small drawings of textures you can find nearby.
steps: Divide a page into 6 small boxes.
Look for textures such as fabric, bark, tiles or a leaf. Draw one in each box.
Choose one box and make a larger version using the same marks.
activities.shared_version: Each person contributes a few boxes to one shared page.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Mix a page of colors
activities.summary: See how many colors you can mix from the paints you already have.
steps: Protect the table and set out a small amount of paint.
Mix pairs of colors and paint a swatch of each mixture.
Pick 3 mixtures and use them to paint a small shape or object.
activities.shared_version: Use the same starting colors and compare the mixtures you make.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Paint a leaf with two colors
activities.summary: Look closely at one leaf and paint its shape with a limited palette.
steps: Choose a leaf you can examine without damaging a plant.
Paint its outline and large areas using 2 colors.
Add a few veins or shadows after the first layer has dried enough for your paint.
activities.shared_version: Paint the same leaf separately, or each choose a different leaf.

required: A leaf or a reference photo you took

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Paint a postcard-sized view
activities.summary: Make a small painting of the view from a window.
steps: Choose a window view and a small piece of suitable paper.
Block in the largest shapes before adding details.
Choose one detail to finish, then leave the painting to dry.
activities.shared_version: Choose the same view and compare which details caught your attention.

optional: Tape for holding paper in place

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Read the opening of a book you already own
activities.summary: Give an unread book a short first try.
steps: Pick a book you can access now.
Read its opening for about 15 minutes.
Mark your place and decide whether you want another session with this book.
activities.shared_version: Each read your own opening, then tell the other person whether you want to continue.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Read a short story in one sitting
activities.summary: Choose a story short enough to finish in the time you have.
steps: Choose a short story you already have access to.
Read to the end, with breaks if you need them.
Pick one scene or sentence you would like to return to.
activities.shared_version: Read the same story separately, then compare which part stayed with you.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Read the same passage in two ways
activities.summary: Try a passage silently, then hear how it sounds aloud.
steps: Choose a short passage from a book you can access.
Read it silently, then read it aloud somewhere you can do so comfortably.
Notice where you pause or change your voice. Read it once more if you want.
activities.shared_version: Take turns reading, or listen to each person read the passage they chose.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Write a scene around a lost object
activities.summary: Start with someone finding an object they were not looking for.
steps: Choose an object and a place where it could be found.
Write what happens when someone picks it up.
End the scene with a choice the person has to make.
activities.shared_version: Write different versions of the same starting scene, then share only if you want to.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Write a conversation without explanations
activities.summary: Let two characters disagree through what they say.
steps: Choose something small for 2 characters to disagree about.
Write their conversation without explaining their feelings between lines.
Read it aloud and change any line that does not sound like the person speaking.
activities.shared_version: Each write one character’s lines, or compare two separate conversations.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Rewrite one scene from another viewpoint
activities.summary: Take a scene you wrote and tell it through someone else in it.
steps: Choose a short scene you have written.
Pick a different character and write what they notice.
Compare the versions and choose which one serves your story.
activities.shared_version: Each take a different viewpoint on a scene you created together.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Photograph five shades of one color
activities.summary: Look for variations of one color around your home or on a short route.
steps: Choose a color and decide where you can look for it.
Photograph 5 examples, paying attention to light and shade.
Choose an order that shows the differences between them.
activities.shared_version: Pick the same color and compare what each person found.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Make an ordinary object look unfamiliar
activities.summary: Use close framing and unusual angles to change how an object looks.
steps: Choose an object you can move or walk around.
Photograph details from close up and from several angles.
Pick 3 frames that show the object in different ways.
activities.shared_version: Take turns choosing an object for the other person to photograph.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Photograph light in one small space
activities.summary: Make a short photo set using the available light near one window.
steps: Choose a small area with daylight and something to photograph.
Move your subject or change your position to try side light, back light and shade.
Keep one image from each setup and compare the shadows.
activities.shared_version: One person moves the subject while the other photographs it, then swap.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Make a chickpea salad from what you have
activities.summary: Use ready-to-eat chickpeas and vegetables to put together a simple meal.
steps: Drain ready-to-eat canned chickpeas and wash the vegetables you choose.
Chop the vegetables and mix them with the chickpeas.
Add a dressing you like, taste, and adjust the seasoning.
activities.shared_version: Divide the chopping and mixing, then choose the final seasoning together.

required: Dressing ingredients that suit your dietary needs

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Cook a small pot of tomato beans
activities.summary: Make a warm dish with ready-cooked beans and canned tomatoes.
steps: Drain a can of ready-cooked beans and put them in a small saucepan with canned tomatoes.
Add seasoning you like and simmer gently, stirring, until the mixture is hot throughout and as thick as you want.
Taste and adjust. Serve with an accompaniment you already have.
activities.shared_version: One person handles the pan while the other prepares the accompaniment.

required: Seasonings that suit your dietary needs

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Roast a tray of vegetables you will actually eat
activities.summary: Choose a few vegetables and use a tested roasting guide for them.
steps: Choose vegetables, wash them and cut them into sizes suited to the roasting guide you are following.
Use a reputable recipe or appliance guide for the oven temperature, tray and cooking time.
Roast until cooked, checking carefully with oven protection. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
activities.shared_version: Choose the vegetables together and share the preparation. One person handles the hot tray.

required: Oil and seasonings that suit your dietary needs
A tested roasting guide for the chosen vegetables

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Make a two-note guitar pattern
activities.summary: Use two comfortable notes to make a short repeating pattern.
steps: Tune the guitar with a tuner you already have access to.
Choose 2 notes you can play comfortably and try a few orders.
Choose one pattern and repeat it slowly with an even pulse.
activities.shared_version: Play a simple pulse for one another, or take turns repeating the pattern.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Practice one chord change slowly
activities.summary: Focus on changing between two chords you are learning.
steps: Choose 2 chord shapes from a lesson or guide you can use.
Place the first shape, sound it, then move slowly to the second.
Repeat with a light touch. Pause if your hand becomes uncomfortable.
activities.shared_version: One person keeps a slow pulse while the other changes chords, then swap.

required: A chord guide you can access

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Try a simple strumming pattern
activities.summary: Practice a steady pattern before adding a full song.
steps: Tune the guitar and choose a comfortable chord or muted strings.
Try slow, evenly spaced downward strums.
Add a pause or change the accents to make a short pattern you can repeat.
activities.shared_version: Take turns making a pattern for the other person to repeat.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Check the care needs of one plant
activities.summary: Find out what a plant you already have needs before changing its care.
steps: Find the plant’s name from its label or a reliable identification source.
Check a reliable guide for its light, watering and drainage needs.
Look at its current spot and container, then choose one change only if it is needed.
activities.shared_version: Work through the guide together and compare what you notice about the plant.

required: A plant you can care for
A reliable care guide for that plant

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Sow a small pot of herbs
activities.summary: Plant a small batch of suitable herb seeds using their packet instructions.
steps: Choose seeds that suit the growing conditions you can provide.
Prepare a clean pot with drainage and a suitable growing medium.
Follow the packet for sowing depth, moisture and light. Label the pot.
activities.shared_version: Share a packet between suitable pots and compare the growing conditions later.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Make useful labels for your plants
activities.summary: Give each plant a label that helps you care for it.
steps: Choose up to 3 plants you can identify.
Write their names and one care point from a reliable guide.
Attach labels without tightening anything around a stem. Keep paper labels out of water.
activities.shared_version: Choose a few plants each and help check the names on the labels.
activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Explore how a knight moves
activities.summary: Use an empty board to get comfortable with the knight’s movement.
steps: Put a knight near the center of an empty chessboard.
Mark or point to the squares it can reach in one move using the L-shaped move.
Move it toward an edge and compare the available squares.
activities.shared_version: Take turns choosing the starting square and finding the legal moves.

required: A guide to the knight’s legal move

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Play chess without a clock
activities.summary: Play at a pace where you can think through a move.
steps: Agree to play without a time limit, or choose an untimed computer setting.
Play a game, checking the rules when you need to.
Choose one move to discuss or review afterward. You can pause and resume if the game takes longer.
activities.shared_version: Use the physical setup and agree that either player can ask a rules question.

required: Access to the rules of chess

options.label: Computer opponent
required_items: Chess program with an untimed opponent

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Replay the opening of a game
activities.summary: Look at the first few moves of a game you played or are allowed to access.
steps: Choose a saved game or a game recorded in a book or accessible guide.
Play through its first 10 moves on a board.
Pause at 3 positions and say what you would consider next.
activities.shared_version: Take turns explaining what you notice about each position.

required: A recorded game you can access

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Notice five details on a familiar route
activities.summary: Look again at a route you already know.
steps: Choose a short public route that suits your access and mobility needs.
Notice 5 details, such as signs, colors, doors, trees or sounds.
Choose one detail you would like to look at again.
activities.shared_version: Take turns choosing a detail to point out. Stay together at a pace that suits both of you.

optional: Clothing or equipment suited to the route and conditions

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Take a short walk with no errands
activities.summary: Choose a nearby loop and give yourself time to look around.
steps: Choose a public route of a manageable length and check any access restrictions.
Walk or move through it at your own pace, with pauses when needed.
Choose one place along it where you might stop another time.
activities.shared_version: Choose the route together and agree on a comfortable turnaround point.

optional: Clothing or equipment suited to the route and conditions

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

activities.title: Make a tiny guide to one block
activities.summary: Collect a few observations about a small public area.
steps: Choose a block or similarly small area you can access.
Make notes about 3 to 5 details you could point out to someone else.
Put them in an order that follows your route. Do not include private addresses or identifiable people without permission.
activities.shared_version: Each choose a few details, then combine them into one short route.

optional: Clothing or equipment suited to the route and conditions

activities.cost_note: Cost unknown. Check supplies, access and travel before starting.

pursuits.title: Make a small drawing collection
pursuits.description: Make 6 drawings of ordinary things, using a few different ways of looking.

milestones.title: Choose 3 subjects
milestones.instruction: Pick objects or views you can return to without buying anything.

milestones.title: Draw each subject twice
milestones.instruction: Try a different line or viewpoint on the second version.

milestones.title: Choose your collection
milestones.instruction: Put 6 drawings together. Add titles if you want.

pursuits.title: Make a set of small paintings
pursuits.description: Use subjects you can find at home to make 4 small paintings.

milestones.title: Try your materials
milestones.instruction: Make a few color swatches and choose a small painting surface.

milestones.title: Make 4 paintings
milestones.instruction: Use a different subject or color combination for each one.

milestones.title: Bring them together
milestones.instruction: Let the paintings dry and choose an order for the set.

pursuits.title: Finish a book you keep meaning to read
pursuits.description: Choose a book, make space for a few reading sessions and work toward its final page.
pursuits.completion_definition: One book finished, if you decide to keep reading it

milestones.title: Choose the book
milestones.instruction: Try a few pages. Choose a different book if this one is not right for you.

milestones.title: Find your way through it
milestones.instruction: Choose a manageable section for each session and keep your place.

milestones.title: Reach the final page
milestones.instruction: Finish the book and decide what, if anything, you want to read next.

pursuits.title: Finish a short story
pursuits.description: Start with one scene and build a short story you can read from beginning to end.
pursuits.completion_definition: One finished short story of a length you choose

milestones.title: Find a scene
milestones.instruction: Choose a character, a place and something the character wants.

milestones.title: Write a first version
milestones.instruction: Give the story a beginning, a change and an ending.

milestones.title: Read and revise
milestones.instruction: Read the whole story and change the parts that do not say what you meant.

pursuits.title: Make a photo set about one ordinary thing
pursuits.description: Choose a subject and make a set of 8 photographs that show different sides of it.

milestones.title: Choose a subject
milestones.instruction: Pick something you can photograph more than once without special access.

milestones.title: Try different approaches
milestones.instruction: Change your distance, angle, framing or available light.

milestones.title: Make the final selection
milestones.instruction: Choose 8 photos that belong together and put them in an order.

pursuits.title: Build a small recipe collection
pursuits.description: Make 3 simple dishes and keep the versions you would cook again.
pursuits.completion_definition: 3 dishes cooked, with your own usable instructions

milestones.title: Choose 3 dishes
milestones.instruction: Check the ingredients, kitchen equipment and dietary needs first.

milestones.title: Cook each dish
milestones.instruction: Follow a suitable recipe or the simple activity instructions and note any changes.

milestones.title: Keep the useful versions
milestones.instruction: Write down enough detail to make each dish again.

pursuits.title: Play one song from start to finish
pursuits.description: Choose a song that fits your current ability and work through its parts at your own pace.
pursuits.completion_definition: One complete play-through of a chosen song

milestones.title: Choose the song
milestones.instruction: Find a suitable lesson, melody or chord guide you can access.

milestones.title: Work through the parts
milestones.instruction: Practice small sections and the changes between them.

milestones.title: Join the parts
milestones.instruction: Try a complete play-through. Slow down or simplify it if that helps.

pursuits.title: Care for one plant and keep a simple record
pursuits.description: Learn what one plant needs and make a record of how you care for it.
pursuits.completion_definition: A plant identified, its care needs checked, and 4 care checks recorded

milestones.title: Identify the plant
milestones.instruction: Use its label or a reliable plant guide to check its light, water and space needs.

milestones.title: Choose its place
milestones.instruction: Find a suitable spot and check its container and drainage.

milestones.title: Make 4 care checks
milestones.instruction: Look at the plant and its growing conditions before deciding what care it needs. Growth is not guaranteed.

pursuits.title: Play a game and explain three choices
pursuits.description: Play a complete game, then look back at a few decisions you made.
pursuits.completion_definition: One completed game and 3 positions discussed or reviewed

milestones.title: Choose how to play
milestones.instruction: Use a physical board with someone or a chess program you can access.

milestones.title: Play a full game
milestones.instruction: Choose a pace that gives you time to think.

milestones.title: Look back at 3 choices
milestones.instruction: Use remembered positions, a saved game or notes to discuss what you considered.

pursuits.title: Make a small guide to a route you enjoy
pursuits.description: Explore a manageable route and choose a few things you would point out to someone else.
pursuits.completion_definition: A route tried and 5 observations collected

milestones.title: Choose a suitable route
milestones.instruction: Start with public places you can access and a distance that suits you.

milestones.title: Try it in small sections
milestones.instruction: Notice details and record them in a way that works for you.

milestones.title: Make your guide
milestones.instruction: Choose 5 observations. Leave private addresses and identifying details out.
